div.div: بَطِرٌ part. n. of بَطِرَ, (Msb, TA,) Exulting, or exulting greatly, or excessively, and behaving insolently and unthankfully, or ungratefully: or exulting by reason of wealth, and behaving with pride and self-conceitedness, and boastfulness, and want of thankfulness: or behaving with the utmost exultation, &c.: see its verb. (A, Msb, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
